wake_up.label: Wake Up
wake_up.subtitle: Good morning, rise and shine!
wake_up.promptText: Good morning, {name}! Time to wake up and start a wonderful day.

make_bed.label: Make Bed
make_bed.subtitle: Let's make the bed nice and neat
make_bed.promptText: Nice work, {name}! Let us make the bed nice and tidy.

brush_teeth.label: Brush Teeth
brush_teeth.subtitle: Let's make those teeth sparkle!
brush_teeth.promptText: It is time to brush your teeth, {name}, for a bright, sparkly smile.

eat_breakfast.label: Eat Breakfast
eat_breakfast.subtitle: Time to fuel up for the day!
eat_breakfast.promptText: Superstar {name}, it is breakfast time. Let us eat and fill up with energy for the day.

get_dressed.label: Get Dressed
get_dressed.subtitle: Time to put on comfy clothes
get_dressed.promptText: Great job, {name}. Now let us get dressed and ready for an amazing day.

put_shoes_on.label: Put Shoes On
put_shoes_on.subtitle: Let's get those shoes on!
put_shoes_on.promptText: Almost ready, {name}. Put your shoes on, and we are good to go.

comb_hair.label: Comb Hair
comb_hair.subtitle: Let's look neat and tidy!
comb_hair.promptText: Looking good, {name}. Time to comb your hair so you can look your best.

part1.text: Let's take care of your hair, {name}!

drink_water.label: Drink Water
drink_water.subtitle: A little sip for sweet dreams
drink_water.promptText: Stay healthy, {name}. Let us drink a big glass of water.

homework.label: Homework
homework.subtitle: Time to focus and learn!
homework.promptText: Great focus, {name}! Let us sit down and finish our homework.

eat_dinner.label: Eat Dinner
eat_dinner.subtitle: Yummy food to end the day!
eat_dinner.promptText: Dinner time, {name}! Let us sit down and enjoy a healthy meal.

tidy_room.label: Tidy Room
tidy_room.subtitle: Let's clean up our space!
tidy_room.promptText: Great job {name}! Now, let us tidy up our room.

part1.text: What a busy day of playing, {name}!

put_on_pajamas.label: Put on Pajamas
put_on_pajamas.subtitle: Time to get cozy for bed
put_on_pajamas.promptText: Time to get cozy, {name}. Let us put on our pajamas!

part1.text: Time to transform for the night, {name}!

bedtime_story.label: Bedtime Story
bedtime_story.subtitle: Let's read a cozy story
bedtime_story.promptText: Cuddle up, {name}. Let us read a lovely bedtime story together.

go_to_sleep.label: Go to Sleep
go_to_sleep.subtitle: Sweet dreams, sleep tight!
go_to_sleep.promptText: Sweet dreams, {name}. It is time to close your eyes and go to sleep.

pack_backpack.label: Pack Backpack
pack_backpack.subtitle: Let's get ready for school!
pack_backpack.promptText: You are doing great, {name}. Let us pack your backpack so you are ready for school.

wash_face.label: Wash Face
wash_face.subtitle: A splash of water to wake up!
wash_face.promptText: Let us wash your face, {name}, and feel fresh and clean.
